page.overview:
Who is Zayn De Witte?

Zayn De Witte was a twisted mentat who previously served House Harkonnen.

Zayn De Witte served House Harkonnen as a twisted mentat. He later deserted due to a falling out with Piter de Vries and began to apply his skills in the underworld.

De Witte was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull in Arrakeen. He told them of his desertion from House Harkonnen and offered to train them in the ways of the mentat. He told them that he would train them if they got rid of the Mobula Gang, who were regularly disrupting his operations.
